features.text: Adaptive Quick Wash
The Adaptive Quick Wash Cycle adjusts cleaning performance and resources based on soil level for the cleanest and fastest quick wash in its class.
SmartBoost® Clean Technology
Patented SmartBoost® Clean technology premixes detergent with water before reaching your dishes, delivering a powerful clean to remove tough baked on foods.
Quiet Operation with Luxury-Quiet System
So quiet your dishwasher won't disturb you, even if you run it while you're in the room - runs at 42 dBA.
MaxDry™ Technology
This brand's most powerful drying feature with a final rinse cycle hot enough to also sanitize.
DishSense® Sensor Technology
Avoid pre-rinsing with our DishSense® sensor technology that automatically adjusts the cycle based on the soil level of your dishes.
Save up to 4,000 gallons of Water Every Year
By avoiding hand washing and putting your dishes straight in the dishwasher you can save up to 4,000 gallons of water per year while getting an effective clean.
Target Wash Zones
Completely clean dishes of all shapes and sizes like water bottles, casserole dishes wine glasses and more with our Target Wash Zones.
LuxCare® Wash Arm
Our exclusive LuxCare® Wash Arm uses water more effectively to tackle even the toughest dishes without wasting valuable resources.
Third-Level Rack
Easily clean serving utensils and culinary tools with the seamless organization of our third-level rack.
Luxury-Glide® Dish Racks
Dish racks so smooth they extend effortlessly to help making loading and unloading easier.
Premium Capacitive Touch User Interface
Sleek designed capacitive multi-touch user interface is intuitive and helps you to easily select the right program for your dish load.
Adjustable Racks
Make loading the dishwasher easier with adjustable racks, providing enough space to fit even your largest items.
National Science Foundation® Certified
Sanitize option removes 99.9% of common household bacteria.
Convenient LED Floor Beam Indicators
Illuminate the floor with a blue light when your dishes are washing and a white light when they are clean.
ENERGY STAR® Most Efficient
This Dishwasher has been designated as one of the Most Efficient ENERGY STAR® certified products in 2025
Platinum Star® Limited Warranty
Exclusive limited warranty that includes two year coverage on parts and one year on labor.
